reason: E2 shows Hf can improve room-temperature properties in single-phase FCC HEAs via precipitation, but this is for different alloy systems and larger Hf amounts; E1 does not mention Hf addition or NbMoTaW. The key premises about ductility improvement in NbMoTaW and maintained high-temperature/irradiation resistance lack direct supporting evidence.
premises: Hf addition to single-phase HEAs can improve room-temperature mechanical properties via precipitation of intermetallic compounds
